name: Hospital / Health System
description: Comprehensive hospital or multi-facility health system with full clinical, administrative, and support services. Designed for acute-care hospitals, medical centers, and integrated delivery networks operating under strict regulatory frameworks (HIPAA, JCI, CMS).

org_structure.overview: The hospital or health system is organized under a dual governance model balancing clinical authority (medical staff / chief of staff) with administrative leadership (CEO / hospital administration). Clinical chiefs report through the Chief of Staff for credentialing and clinical quality, while administrative leaders report through the CEO for operational and financial performance. This matrix creates shared accountability for patient outcomes, regulatory compliance, and fiscal stewardship. Departments span inpatient and outpatient care, diagnostic services, support services, and corporate functions.

departments.name: Executive Leadership
departments.description: C-suite and senior leadership setting strategic direction, financial performance, and organizational culture. Responsible for board reporting, community relations, and enterprise-wide decision-making.

roles.title: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
roles.description: Overall strategic leader; ultimate accountability for quality of care, financial health, and regulatory compliance.

roles.title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
roles.description: Oversees day-to-day hospital operations, ancillaries, and support services through department directors.

roles.title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
roles.description: Financial planning, revenue cycle management, budgeting, payer contracting, and treasury.

roles.title: Chief Nursing Officer (CNO)
roles.description: Nursing practice standards, nursing workforce, patient care delivery across all inpatient units.

roles.title: Chief Medical Officer / Chief of Staff
roles.description: Physician leadership, clinical quality, credentialing, medical staff governance.

roles.title: Chief Information Officer (CIO)
roles.description: Health IT, EHR systems (Epic/Cerner), cybersecurity, data analytics.

roles.title: Chief Compliance Officer
roles.description: Regulatory compliance, HIPAA privacy/security, accreditation, risk management.

roles.title: Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO)
roles.description: Workforce planning, labor relations, recruitment, benefits, employee health.

departments.name: Clinical / Medical Staff
departments.description: Organized medical staff governing clinical care delivery. Department chairs oversee their specialty, while attending physicians, residents, and fellows provide direct patient care.

roles.title: Department Chair — Internal Medicine
roles.description: Clinical and administrative leadership for internal medicine; oversees hospitalists and subspecialties.

roles.title: Department Chair — Surgery
roles.description: Clinical and administrative leadership for surgical services including general, orthopedic, cardiovascular, and neuro surgery.

roles.title: Department Chair — Emergency Medicine
roles.description: Leadership of the emergency department; board-certified emergency physician managing ED physicians and throughput.

roles.title: Department Chair — Pediatrics
roles.description: Clinical leadership for pediatric services including NICU if applicable.

roles.title: Department Chair — OB/GYN
roles.description: Women's health services including labor and delivery, gynecologic surgery.

roles.title: Department Chair — Radiology
roles.description: Imaging services oversight; ensures quality and safety of all diagnostic and interventional radiology.

roles.title: Department Chair — Pathology & Laboratory Medicine
roles.description: Clinical pathology, anatomic pathology, transfusion services, and lab operations.

roles.title: Attending Physician — Hospitalist
roles.description: Inpatient internal medicine; manages hospitalized patients including admissions, daily rounds, and discharges.

roles.title: Attending Physician — Specialist
roles.description: Subspecialty physician (cardiology, neurology, oncology, gastroenterology, etc.) providing consultative and procedural care.

roles.title: Resident Physician
roles.description: Physician in postgraduate training rotating through specialties under attending supervision.

roles.title: Fellow
roles.description: Subspecialty trainee post-residency (e.g., cardiology, critical care, oncology).

departments.name: Nursing Services
departments.description: All inpatient and outpatient nursing units. Includes med-surg, ICU, ED, OR, maternal-child, and specialty nursing areas.

roles.title: Director of Nursing — Medical-Surgical
roles.description: Oversees multiple med-surg units; manages nurse managers and patient throughput.

roles.title: Director of Nursing — Critical Care
roles.description: Oversees ICU, CCU, and intermediate care units; ensures staffing and quality in high-acuity areas.

roles.title: Director of Nursing — Perioperative Services
roles.description: Operating room, PACU, and ambulatory surgery nursing services.

roles.title: Nurse Manager — Med-Surg Unit
roles.description: Day-to-day operations of a specific nursing unit; staffing, scheduling, patient safety, and unit budget.

roles.title: Registered Nurse (RN) — Staff Nurse
roles.description: Direct patient care including assessment, medication administration, care planning, and patient education.

roles.title: Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN)
roles.description: Provides basic nursing care under RN supervision; vital signs, wound care, medication administration where licensed.

roles.title: Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA)
roles.description: ADL assistance, vital signs, mobility support, and basic patient care tasks under nursing supervision.

roles.title: Clinical Nurse Educator
roles.description: Orientation, continuing education, competency assessment, and evidence-based practice implementation for nursing staff.

departments.name: Allied Health & Diagnostic Services
departments.description: Clinical services delivered by non-physician, non-nursing licensed professionals. Includes rehabilitation, respiratory therapy, imaging, and laboratory.

roles.title: Director of Rehabilitation Services
roles.description: Oversees physical therapy, occupational therapy, and speech-language pathology.

roles.title: Physical Therapist (PT)
roles.description: Evaluation and treatment of patients with mobility and functional limitations.

roles.title: Occupational Therapist (OT)
roles.description: Helps patients regain daily living skills and functional independence.

roles.title: Speech-Language Pathologist (SLP)
roles.description: Assessment and treatment of swallowing, communication, and cognitive-communication disorders.

roles.title: Respiratory Therapist
roles.description: Pulmonary function testing, ventilator management, oxygen therapy, and emergency airway support.

roles.title: Clinical Lab Scientist / Technologist
roles.description: Performs diagnostic testing on patient specimens in hematology, chemistry, microbiology, and blood bank.

roles.title: Radiologic Technologist
roles.description: Performs X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, and other diagnostic imaging procedures.

roles.title: Pharmacist — Clinical
roles.description: Medication order review, clinical consultation, pharmacokinetic dosing, antimicrobial stewardship, patient education.

roles.title: Pharmacy Technician
roles.description: Medication preparation, inventory management, and pharmacy operations under pharmacist supervision.

departments.name: Support & Ancillary Services
departments.description: Non-clinical services critical to hospital operations: dietary, environmental, facilities, security, supply chain.

roles.title: Director of Environmental Services
roles.description: Housekeeping, linen, waste management, infection control support through environmental cleaning.

roles.title: Director of Food & Nutrition Services
roles.description: Patient meal services, cafeteria operations, clinical nutrition / dietetics, and therapeutic diets.

roles.title: Director of Facilities & Engineering
roles.description: Building maintenance, HVAC, medical gas systems, electrical, plumbing, life safety systems.

roles.title: Director of Security & Safety
roles.description: Hospital security, access control, emergency preparedness, workplace violence prevention.

roles.title: Registered Dietitian
roles.description: Medical nutrition therapy, patient nutritional assessment, enteral/parenteral nutrition support.

roles.title: Environmental Services Technician
roles.description: Room cleaning, waste disposal, terminal cleaning of patient rooms and OR suites.

roles.title: Facilities Technician
roles.description: Maintenance and repair of hospital building systems and equipment.

departments.name: Revenue Cycle & Finance
departments.description: Financial operations including patient billing, coding, insurance reimbursement, payer contracting, and materials management.

roles.title: Director of Revenue Cycle
roles.description: Patient registration, charge capture, coding, billing, collections, and denial management.

roles.title: Certified Medical Coder
roles.description: Translates clinical documentation into ICD-10 and CPT codes for billing and reimbursement.

roles.title: Patient Account Representative
roles.description: Patient billing, insurance follow-up, payment posting, and account resolution.

roles.title: Financial Analyst
roles.description: Budgeting, financial modeling, cost accounting, variance analysis, and decision support.

roles.title: Supply Chain Manager
roles.description: Procurement, inventory management, group purchasing organization (GPO) administration, and vendor contracting.

key_relationships: Chief of Staff (physician leader) and CEO (administrative leader) share joint accountability for quality outcomes and patient safety — a foundational hospital governance relationship.
Department Chairs report to the Chief of Staff for clinical credentials and quality, but coordinate with the COO for resource allocation, staffing, and operational budget.
CNO and Chief of Staff collaborate on nurse-physician communication protocols, code response teams, and patient experience initiatives.
Compliance Officer works across all departments to ensure HIPAA privacy, JCI/CMS accreditation standards, and fraud/abuse prevention.
Revenue Cycle Director partners with Clinical Departments for accurate charge capture and documentation integrity (CDI).
Pharmacy Director reports to the Chief of Staff clinically but coordinates with COO on budget and operations; works closely with nursing on medication safety.
Environmental Services and Nursing collaborate daily on room turnaround, infection control, and isolation protocols.
Emergency Department Chair and Director of Nursing — Emergency maintain joint oversight of ED throughput, boarding, and disaster response.
